instruction: - Write out the code. - For each file changed provide detailed description of logic changed. - If new files should be created in codebase provide `touch` fish commands first. - If files require no change but require renaming or moving provide fish commands first. - If any AGENTIC actions can be done (except editing a LOT of text), provide all fish commands as well.
important_constraints: - For file scopes specified by the user always write `crates.io` Rust styled inline comments - Never write inline comments for file scopes NOT specified - When implementing new logic never keep the backwards compatability logic. - Focus on simple implementation with minimal diff.
docs_style_guidelines: - Never use `1.`, `2.`, etc... numbering inside documentation comments. - ALWAYS style docs in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, to make them clear and straightforward.
